Nadia: Following the modularization RFC - need a concrete migration checklist for splitting the runtime hot path. Minimal safe contract suggestions?

Owen: Keep it tiny: request envelope (tenant, id, flags), KV ops (GetPrefix, PutBatch, Invalidate), and a WarmPrefix API. Backwards compat header please.

Priya: Add a cache-consistency test across restarts and a golden eviction scenario. Those bugs are subtle.

Harper: Owner boundaries: runtime-exec owns cache lifecycle and eviction; router owns placement and tenant mapping. Router can request warms but not evictions.

Nadia: Agreed. We'll expose a thin adapter API and keep it stable. Plan: extract adapter + CI contracts -> colocate adapter on canary -> shadow traffic -> enable routing for small tenant slice -> ramp.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster created: split-hotpath-canary-01 (image: rwinf/runtime:split-1).

Owen: Add compatibility header X-Facet-Version: 1 and /_facet/health returning schema_version. CI should run compatibility matrix.

Priya: Perf gate: region-aware P99 delta budget, default +4ms tail. Block if exceeded.

Harper: Rollout steps in runbook: prechecks (CI green, perf baseline), canary shadow 7 days, 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated abort on error% or latency regressions.

Nadia: Fallback behavior: if tenant mapping missing or CDC lag, route to monolith and emit facet_fallback metric + logs (sampled in prod).

Owen: We'll colocate router+adapter initially to avoid an extra network hop for hot-paths. Measure extra round-trips for later split.

Priya: Tests: include a deliberate fallback integration test to verify logging and metrics. Also require traces for cross-facet RPCs.

Harper: Volunteers: @Owen adapter PR, @Priya perf harness, @Harper runbook. I'll coordinate RFC update and postmortem checklist.

Nadia: Timeline: adapter PR in 5 days, contract CI next week, canary after contracts pass. Add post-rollout retrospective step even if smooth.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for 1785551320.

Owen: ack.

Priya: ack, will publish perf numbers.

Harper: I'll post runbook link when ready.

Nadia: Thanks all. DM me for blockers. :thumbsup:
